title: CS 4535: Code Review 1
description: Due Mon Nov 2, 11:59pm ET. About 5 minutes once your reviews are posted.
completedHtml:
Submitted.

The authors answer your reviews by Tue Nov 3 at 11:59pm, so keep an eye on both threads. If a review found a conflict with another team's stack, tell Jon.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: Your reviews are on GitHub, and this survey is where we find them. You were requested as a reviewer on two stacks: one a teammate's and one from another team. Link the review you submitted on every PR in each stack. Each one starts with an Agent line. See Code Review 1.

elements.name: teammate_stack
elements.title: Link to the stack's issue, or to its last PR

validators.text: Paste the full link to an issue or PR on pawtograder/platform, such as https://github.com/pawtograder/platform/issues/977

elements.name: teammate_reviews
elements.title: Links to your GitHub reviews, one per line
elements.description: One for each PR in the stack. On the PR, open the three-dot menu on your review and choose Copy link. The link ends in #pullrequestreview- and a number.

validators.text: One review link per line, such as https://github.com/pawtograder/platform/pull/1090#pullrequestreview-3412345678. A comment link (#issuecomment-) isn't a submitted review.

elements.name: outside
elements.title: Stack 2: from another team
elements.description: This one counts toward the two reviews outside your team.

elements.name: blockers
elements.title: Anything that got in the way?
elements.description: Optional. A stack that wasn't review-ready, a review request that never arrived, or a PR that changed while you were reading it.
